episodes.208779: An Atmospheric River in the middle of November brought light mountain snow, widespread rainfall with roadway flooding, gusty winds, and thunderstorms from November 12th through November 14th. Around 1 to 4 inches of rain were observed across interior northern California over this 48 hour period. Gusty southerly winds of 25 to 65 mph were also observed as well. 4 to 12 inches of snow was estimated to have fallen at the highest peaks, generally above 8000 feet in the Sierra Nevada, mainly south of US Highway 50.
episodes.211615: A powerful early-season winter storm brought significant rainfall to Southwestern California. Rainfall totals ranged from 2 to 8 inches across coastal and valley areas with 6 to 12 inches across the foothills and mountains. With such rainfall totals, significant reports of flooding were received.

events.narrative: California Highway Patrol reported roadway flooding along portions of Interstate 80 east near Greenback Lane.
California Highway Patrol reported roadway flooding impacting portions of US Highway 50 east near the Cedar Grove offramp.
Heavy rainfall generated rockslides just north of the intersection of Highway 1 and Highway 101. California Highway Patrol reported six large rocks blocking the roadway.
Heavy rainfall generated flash flooding across Highway 101. California Highway Patrol reported significant flooding across all northbound lanes of Highway 101.
Heavy rainfall generated significant debris flows across Highway 154. California Highway Patrol reported rocks across all lanes of Highway 154, west of Cathedral Oaks Boulevard.

Heavy rainfall generated significant debris flows across Highway 101. California Highway Patrol reported six inches of mud across Highway 101 near El Capitan State Beach. Several vehicles were stuck in the mud.
Heavy rainfall generated significant rockslides across Highway 150. Law enforcement reported significant rockslide, blocking the roadway.

California Highway Patrol reported that a 71 year old man drowned after his car was swept into a creek crossing as a bridge flooded on Fifield Road in Pleasant Grove in Sutter County due to heavy rain.
